# costgraph_tenant (Resource)

Create a tenant to separate infrastructure, integrations, and costs within your CostGraph organization.

Requires an API key whose account is an active organization owner and whose explicitly granted scopes include organization:manage. Existing tenant keys do not gain this permission automatically. The accompanying organization management API must be available on the deployment.

Destroying the resource deactivates the tenant and revokes its access. Historical records are retained. Reference this tenant from child integration resources so Terraform disconnects them before deactivating the tenant. CostGraph refuses deletion of the default tenant and the tenant that owns the active API key.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "costgraph_tenant" "production" {
  name = "Production"
}

output "production_tenant_id" {
  value = costgraph_tenant.production.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Tenant name. It must not be blank or begin or end with whitespace. Updates rename the tenant in place.

### Optional

- `organization_id` (String) Organization UUID. Defaults to the organization associated with the API key. The key must have organization-management permission in this organization. Changing it replaces the tenant.

### Read-Only

- `active` (Boolean) Whether the tenant is active. Active state is reported by CostGraph and is not a configurable setting.
- `id` (String) Tenant UUID assigned by CostGraph.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import costgraph_tenant.production '00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000001/00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000002'
```
